senses.gloss: m. (חלף) a species of willow with serried leaves (v. preced.; Fl. to Levy Targ. Dict. I, 4251 “so called from its fast growth”).
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 34a:7">Succ. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>משכחת לה בח׳ גילא</he> Ms. M. a. Rashi (ed. <he>כי תניא האי בח׳ וכ׳</he>) (‘a willow the leaves of which are not serried like the teeth of a saw, but like those of a sickle’) refers to a willow with rounded leaves.—[<cite ref="Sukkah 34a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>ח׳ ערבתא</he> Rashi, v. <cite ref="H01108"><he>חִלְפְתָא</he></cite>.]—Pl. <cite ref="H00783"><he>חִילְפֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 152a:4">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> <he>סבותא כלילא דח׳</he> old age is a crown of willow rods (heavy to wear).
